name: godot-codex
description: Live Godot editor control through a local MCP bridge, with native GDScript and C# development skills.

interface.shortDescription: Control Godot 2D/3D scenes from your AI tools.
interface.longDescription: Local stdio MCP plus a project-local Godot EditorPlugin for guarded live scene/node/property/signal/script/resource operations. Includes native GDScript and C# skills, tests and fixtures. Godot must be running with the addon enabled. Independent project, not an official Godot product.
defaultPrompt: Create and save a 3D scene in my running Godot editor.
Inspect this scene and fix its node and signal setup.
Build a 2D scene using my existing C# scripts.
